build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet18 model with SimpleBlock for image classification on 1000 classes
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet50 model with BottleneckBlock for image classification on 1000 classes
create_custom_resnet: create a custom ResNet model by specifying block type, layer counts, and output dimensions
create_resnet_trunk_only: create a ResNet10 model with only_trunk=True to skip the classifier head
init_conv_batchnorm_layer: init a Conv2d or BatchNorm2d layer using fan-in weight initialization
